Legibility

Use the meter as a control

Push it asks how far this design can go before it stops reading. It scales every control’s distance from its default by one factor, then searches for the largest factor where nine probe characters — from one stroke to thirty — all still score above the floor. A timid design gets driven harder; an overcooked one gets pulled back.

Scores the whole set under this design and shows which broke first.
